card.name: Mixed word endings and joining words
card.fires_on: Mostly the ending of a split-up word, such as 'ista' in Batista, 'mic' in proarrhythmic, and 'ers' in Capitalist Roaders. Also a few small joining words like 'or', 'and' and 'increase' in the middle of a sentence.

modes.label: Ends of split names and terms
modes.description: Final piece of a rare name or long term that was broken into parts.
modes.example: The Bat<<ista>>’s soldiers arrested, tortured and questioned many

modes.label: Linking words mid-sentence
modes.description: A joining word or verb such as 'or', 'and', 'increase' inside a list or clause.
modes.example: Corticosteroids decrease bone formation and<< increase>> bone resorption which may lead to development

card.plain: It fires on the last piece of a rare split word and on a few joining words, with no single theme.
